correctness.rationale: The rank-two data matrix Q0 is symmetric and idempotent because its two rank-one blocks use disjoint coordinate supports and norms 14,30. For the smooth ruling curve, any trace objective is G/L with deg L=10 and derivative numerator degree at most 18. The exact standard-library checker constructs Q0 objective and verifies deg H=18, gcd(H,H' )=1, gcd(H,L)=gcd(G,L)=1 and gcd(H,p1*p2)=1. The latter removes all critical points on cut(Q0), a necessary GD rather than ED condition. Nonvanishing resultants and irreducibility of the projection Grassmannian give the generic 18-point count. Computations were actually run.

value.rationale: The scroll \(S(2,3)\) is the first asymmetric rational normal surface scroll under the \(n_i\ge2\) convention used in the motivating literature. Its ruling-line curve is a canonical low-dimensional model for fitting an observed line by chordal distance. GD is the algebraic optimization degree for rank-two projection observations; unlike ED its value is neither implied by nor generally equal to the unrestricted ED degree. The exact value 18, with an explicit valid data witness and cut-locus verification, supplies a natural benchmark and settles an unknown exact invariant for this curve without arbitrary parameter slicing or claims about all scrolls.
